---
title: Tuna Pâté
id: MAR-0011
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 50
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 300 g tuna in oil
- 120 g butter
- 5 anchovy fillets
- to taste mayonnaise (to taste)
## Method
1. Drain the tuna from the oil and crumble it finely, add the chopped anchovies and the butter broken into pieces at room temperature.
2. Work the ingredients by mashing them with a fork and mixing them until they are completely blended, forming a creamy mixture.
3. Transfer the mixture to a terrine, cover it, and place it in the refrigerator to solidify for a few hours.
4. Serve the tuna pâté garnished with the mayonnaise.
